content.text:
Both pairs reviewed against the key.

**1 — performance_fee:** The key's substance is a two-tier carry: 20% base after return of all Capital Contributions, stepping up to 25% only after LPs receive 3.0x paid-in capital, plus whole-fund basis, no preferred return/catch-up, GP commitment exclusion and clawback. The answer captures only the 25% top tier and omits the 20% base rate and the 3.0x threshold value — a materially different (and higher) stated fee.

**2 — key_man_provision:** The two named Key Persons match exactly, but the key requires the trigger events and consequences (automatic Investment Period suspension, 10% follow-on carve-out, 180-day Majority in Interest cure or permanent termination). The answer is a bare list of names with none of the operative mechanics.

pairs.note: Answer states only the 25% stepped-up rate. It omits the 20% base carried interest applying after return of all Capital Contributions and does not define the Step-Up Threshold (cumulative distributions of 3.0x aggregate Capital Contributions), so it misstates the fee as a flat 25%. Also drops whole-fund basis/no preferred return, the prospective-only application, GP Commitment and Affiliated LP exclusions, and clawback.

The two Key Persons named (Delphine Wrexcombe and Tobias Quennell) match the key, but the answer supplies nothing else: no Key Person Event triggers (death/incapacity, ceasing to devote substantially all business time, ceasing to be a managing member of the GP), no automatic Investment Period suspension with the 10% follow-on carve-out, and no 180-day Majority in Interest continuation vote or permanent termination. Required elements of the provision are missing.
